root_causes.note: a GGUF with an empty metadata key aborts the whole process on load
an array metadata value with a mismatched element type aborts the loader

impact: LLM03 poisoned GGUF -> process abort (denial of service). No memory primitive; does not climb to code execution or memory disclosure on this surface.
caveat: The assertions capped the fuzzer's depth, so 0 memory corruption means none found up to the assertion walls, not a proof of absence. A deeper campaign would neuter the known asserts and re-fuzz.
